This implies that Progesterone may influence the expression or function of J82, which in turn affects the activity of Vismodegib and ultimately Solute carrier organic anion transporter family member 2B1. The evidence suggests a possible regulatory pathway where Progesterone could modulate the expression or activity of the downstream target, Solute carrier organic anion transporter family member 2B1. The integration of these interactions highlights a potential role for Progesterone in regulating the activity of this transporter, though further experimental validation is needed to confirm the exact mechanism and functional significance.
